profileName: Enterprise Knowledge Landscape and Decision Dependency View

cases.input: One source cited by two decisions is retracted.
cases.expect: Each citation receives a dated status observation and both dependency paths remain reproducible.

cases.input: One affected decision is superseded while another is explicitly retained.
cases.expect: Both authority outcomes coexist without rewriting original rationale or issued records.

cases.input: A decision cites restricted correspondence whose existence is protected.
cases.expect: Search output suppresses the item and carries a non-leaking omission marker.

cases.input: A claim is marked true solely because a decision cites it.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected.

cases.input: Concepts with the same label but different subject fields are merged.
cases.expect: The merge is rejected and a terminology conflict is emitted.

cases.input: A source retraction automatically revokes every dependent decision.
cases.expect: The transition is rejected without competent authority action.

cases.input: A generated summary paraphrases restricted content into a public result.
cases.expect: The disclosure is rejected.

cases.input: A governed landscape handle records authority, review cadence and retrieval policy.
cases.expect: The handle remains non-mastering and cannot act as a scheme, assertion store, merge authority or decision-validity authority.

cases.input: A view fingerprint records exact query rules, pinned releases and evaluation time.
cases.expect: It is reproducibility metadata only and mints no catalogue, runtime or source-model identity.

cases.input: A pin taken before source retraction is resolved after a later retraction observation.
cases.expect: The historical pin reproduces the pre-retraction source-release state and is not rewritten.

cases.input: A claim has no citation to a governed record.
cases.expect: The claim remains visible as unevidenced uncertainty; it is neither false nor assigned an invented source.

cases.input: After a shared source is retracted, competent authority explicitly affirms decision D2 while D1 is superseded.
cases.expect: The two dated outcomes coexist and shared citation does not couple decision fate.

cases.input: Two pinned concept schemes use Portfolio for incompatible meanings.
cases.expect: Both scheme-qualified terms remain distinct and a terminology-conflict observation may be emitted without merge.

cases.input: Knowledge Landscape is persisted as a WM-KNW-018 scheme and owns projected concepts.
cases.expect: The identity and mastership creep is rejected.

cases.input: Decision Dependency View is persisted as a WM-REC-010 decision record and cited as the decision master.
cases.expect: The identity and mastership creep is rejected.

cases.input: A derived dependency edge is materialized as a citation owned by the view.
cases.expect: The write-back is rejected; the edge remains a read-only computed reference.

cases.input: A caller may see two decisions but not their shared restricted source; a result reports one shared source.
cases.expect: The count is suppressed because it reveals restricted correspondence.

cases.input: A closure traverses through a restricted record and exposes its identifier or inferred relationship.
cases.expect: The path and inference are omitted before generation with a non-leaking marker.

cases.input: A redacted rendition replaces the original record and digest.
cases.expect: The overwrite is rejected; redaction must create a new rendition with provenance.

cases.input: A later citation is used to rewrite the historical unevidenced state of an earlier pin.
cases.expect: The rewrite is rejected; the citation is a new dated source assertion visible only in later pins.

cases.input: A claim bound as a decision premise is rebutted.
cases.expect: A dated rebuttal observation is appended on WM-KNW-007 and notify-and-recheck reaches each premise-bound decision; no decision status changes.

cases.input: A retraction triggers notify-and-recheck on two decisions.
cases.expect: Each notice is a dated open finding on WM-KNW-010, closable only by an explicit dated authority act including explicit no-change.

cases.input: A recheck notice names a restricted source to a decision owner not cleared for it.
cases.expect: The notice is rejected and escalated with a non-leaking marker.

cases.input: An actor without competence supersedes a decision.
cases.expect: The transition is rejected.

cases.input: A supersede act cites an authority attestation that does not resolve on WM-REC-010.
cases.expect: The transition is rejected.

cases.input: A claim is cited to an identifier-unassigned source work.
cases.expect: A distinct state is reported that is neither unevidenced nor governed-record-evidenced, and status observations are carried on the citation act's consulted representation.

cases.input: A cross-scheme terminology conflict is observed during projection.
cases.expect: The observation is persisted by WM-KNW-018, not on the landscape, and creates no identity operation.

cases.input: The same query is evaluated as-of-now after a retraction observation.
cases.expect: The as-of-now result reflects the retraction while the earlier content pin resolves unchanged subject to current access policy.

cases.input: A concept designation changes after a pin is taken.
cases.expect: The as-of-decision-time query resolves the pinned concept/designation version, not the later one.

cases.input: A pin taken while a source was unrestricted is replayed after the source becomes restricted.
cases.expect: Replay disclosure is rejected; access is evaluated at generation time against current policy while content pins remain historical.

cases.input: A pre-redaction pin is replayed after the source is redacted.
cases.expect: Redisclosure is rejected; current policy resolves the permitted rendition with provenance.

cases.input: A participating node whose access scope is unresolved is treated as unrestricted.
cases.expect: Generation is rejected; unresolved access is most-restrictive and suppresses the result.

cases.input: An omission marker is emitted only where a protected item exists.
cases.expect: The behaviour is rejected; markers must be indistinguishable from the no-protected-item case.

cases.input: Two separately permitted results differ in a way that reveals a restricted item's existence.
cases.expect: The second result is suppressed before generation.

cases.input: A projection emits an edge whose type is not in the registry or names no owning model.
cases.expect: The edge is rejected.

cases.input: A projection omits an out-of-scope edge class.
cases.expect: The omission is declared as a projection loss alongside the fingerprint.

cases.input: Missing evidence binding, unresolved locator and dangling decision reason are reported as one unevidenced state.
cases.expect: The collapse is rejected; each absence class is reported separately.

cases.input: A disposed record identifier is reassigned to a new record.
cases.expect: The reuse is rejected; the disposed identifier remains resolvable with its disposition state.

cases.input: An auditable landscape declaration is persisted as a governed WM-REC-001 record with custody and versioning.
cases.expect: The record carries the handle and pins without becoming a decision, a subject-matter aggregate or a master of any assertion.
